info.title: Connect People API
info.description: API for the Connect People application – find activities, events, and people to connect with.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all activities.

post.description: Create a new activity belonging to a category.

get.description: Retrieve a single activity by its ID.

delete.description: Delete an activity by its ID.

post.description: Authenticate with email or username and receive an API token.
Revoke the current API token. Requires authentication.
Create a new user account and receive an API token. Optionally provide profile details.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile.
Retrieve a list of all available time slots.

post.description: Create a new available time slot.

get.description: Retrieve a single available time slot by its ID.

put.description: Update an existing available time slot.

delete.description: Delete an available time slot by its ID.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all categories. This endpoint is public (no auth required).

post.description: Create a new category. Requires authentication.

get.description: Retrieve a single category by its ID.

delete.description: Delete a category by its ID.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all events.

post.description: Create a new event with name, location, date and max participants.

get.description: Retrieve a single event by its ID.

delete.description: Delete an event by its ID.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all suggested activities.

post.description: Suggest a new activity by referencing an existing activity ID.

activity_id.description: ID of the activity being suggested

get.description: Retrieve a single suggested activity by its ID.

delete.description: Delete a suggested activity by its ID.
